reasoning: Brazil is historically the most successful World Cup nation with 5 titles, but hasn't won since 2002. They have a talented squad but have underperformed in recent tournaments (eliminated in quarterfinals in 2022). The 2026 World Cup has an expanded 48-team format, increasing competition. Strong contenders include France, Argentina (current holders), England, Germany, and Spain. Brazil typically has around 8-12% implied probability in betting markets for major tournaments.
